real_name: Uzair Jan Baloch (cousin/successor of Rehman Dakait in real life)
real_life_notes: Real Uzair Baloch was Rehman Dakait's cousin and successor as People's Aman Committee (PAC) leader. Arrested by Pakistan in 2016 and tried for espionage — was found to have links to both Iran's IRGC and, allegedly, Indian intelligence. His case remains murky. The film keeps his real name.
objective: Inherit Rehman Dakait's criminal empire after his death; maintain ISI patronage while exploring independent revenue streams
oracle_role_note: Uzair is more relevant in Film 2 (post-Dakait death). His unknown allegiances (Iran? ISI? self-interest?) make him a high-VoI intelligence target — the 'aalam_allegiance' analog for the Pakistani side.
